elections.description: First Columbus City Council district elections under the 2018 charter amendment. All nine seats filled simultaneously. All Columbus voters voted in all nine races.
elections.source: Franklin County Board of Elections — certified Official Canvass

districts.notes: Unopposed. Favor drew a 2-year term in the January 2024 lot; did not seek re-election in 2025.
Unopposed. Elected Council President. Previously served on council under the at-large system.

elections.term_note: In January 2024, council members drew lots to determine initial term lengths. Districts 1, 3, 4, 7 drew 2-year terms (up for re-election in 2025). Districts 2, 5, 6, 8, 9 drew 4-year terms (up in 2027). All future terms are 4 years.

elections.description: Second district election cycle. Districts 1, 3, 4, and 7 on ballot — the four members who drew 2-year terms in the January 2024 lot drawing.
elections.source: Franklin County Board of Elections — certified Official Canvass

primary.notes: Primary canceled for Districts 1, 3, and 4 — only one candidate filed in each. District 7 had a contested primary; the top two advanced to November.

districts.notes: Unopposed. Wyche re-elected to a 4-year term ending 2029.
Unopposed. Dorans re-elected to a 4-year term ending 2029. Serves as President Pro Tem.
Unopposed. Remy re-elected to a 4-year term ending 2029.
Ross won the open seat vacated by Shayla Favor. Elected to a 4-year term ending 2029.

elections.description: No City Council seats are on the ballot. Columbus voters decide two proposed charter amendments on how City Council is elected.

measures.label: Proposed Amendment No. 1
measures.title: Our City, Our Say — district-only elections
measures.description: A citizen-petition amendment that would switch to district-only City Council elections, keeping nine districts and the current map.

measures.label: Proposed Amendment No. 2
measures.title: A 13-member hybrid council
measures.description: A Council-referred amendment that would expand council to 13 members — the nine district seats plus four elected at-large — with a 2028 district-map redraw.

upcoming.notes: Districts 2, 5, 6, 8, 9 — members who drew 4-year terms in January 2024. All future terms are 4 years, staggered. Conditional: if Proposed Amendment No. 2 (Council's 13-member expansion) passes in November 2026, the 2027 ballot would also include the first two of four new at-large seats.
